title: Adaptive Residual Quantization for Memory-Efficient Temporal Action Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temporal action segmentation (TAS) is commonly trained on large banks of pre-extracted frame features, but storing and replaying those features becomes a practical bottleneck for long-form video, especially in incremental TAS where past-task data must remain available to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Recent TAS replay and condensation methods reduce this burden, but they rely on dense frame-wise annotations and allocate storage through fixed segment-level structures, limiting their flexibility for long procedural videos whose frame complexity varies substantially over time. We introduce Adaptive Residual-Quantized Variational AutoEncoder (ARQ-VAE), a compact and label-free memory representation for TAS features that learns a discrete residual quantization of frame-level video features and then adaptively truncates the residual chain on a per-frame basis, retaining only the residual prefix that best reconstructs each frame feature.

translated_title: 用于内存高效时序动作分割的自适应残差量化
translated_abstract: 时序动作分割（TAS）通常在大型预提取的帧特征库上进行训练，但存储和回放这些特征对长视频而言已成为实际瓶颈，尤其是在增量式TAS中，必须保留过去任务的数据以缓解灾难性遗忘。近期的TAS回放和压缩方法减轻了这一负担，但它们依赖于密集的逐帧标注，并通过固定的片段级结构分配存储空间，限制了其对帧复杂度随时间显著变化的长程序视频的灵活性。我们提出了自适应残差量化变分自编码器（ARQ-VAE），这是一种紧凑且无需标签的TAS特征记忆表示，它学习帧级视频特征的离散残差量化，然后在逐帧基础上自适应地截断残差链，仅保留能最佳重构每个帧特征的残差前缀。
tldr: 提出自适应残差量化变分自编码器（ARQ-VAE），通过学习无标签的离散残差量化并逐帧自适应截断残差链，为时序动作分割提供内存高效且灵活适应帧复杂度变化的特征记忆表示。
en_tdlr: Proposes ARQ-VAE, a compact label-free memory representation for temporal action segmentation that learns discrete residual quantization and adaptively truncates the residual chain on a per-frame basis, enabling memory-efficient feature storage that flexibly adapts to varying frame complexity.
